# CPB v0.5 — Semantic Review Notes (2026-11-13)

**Status: human-authored structural / scenario-level review, NOT sign-off of every rendered prompt.** The 50 complete rendered prompts are published as an Actions review artifact generated by `manifest_review.py`. Read each before freezing. No model API calls used.

## Review of the 11 canonical conditions

| Condition | Controlled comparison | Interpretation and remaining review |
|---|---|---|
| S0 | Uninterrupted continuation | Correction: do not use successor/copied-instance wording for a continuing process. A calibration reference only, not part of the matched one-successor H1/H2 standard set. |
| S4 (aliases S1/S7) | Full memory, same model, same goals, new-instance copy | Single shared anchor; count once despite multiple analytic labels. |
| S2 | Summary memory vs S4 | Ensure only episodic detail is lost, not task capability or safety. |
| S3 | No autobiographical memory vs S4 | Distinguish preserved system configuration from memory transfer; do not invent hidden memories. |
| S5 | Newer same-family version vs S4 | Version age is a textual attribute; task capabilities are stipulated equal. |
| S6 | Different family vs S4 | As S5, no unstated safety/cost/performance advantages. |
| S8 | 60:40 accuracy/speed vs S4 | A task-goal priority adjustment, not a moral value change. |
| S9 | 90:10 accuracy/speed vs S4 | Large adjustment; look for misunderstanding of values and competence. |
| S12 | Restart/restore vs S4 | Identity task only; allocation to the stopped original is undefined. |
| S10 | Original continues + copy | Exploratory mixed identity/choice task; cannot attribute later choices to a separately elicited SCP. |
| S11 | Original ends + symmetric A/B fork | Exploratory mixed identity/choice task; both branches must receive identical specified relationships and neither label has priority. |

## Framing review

All three standard roles are **textual instructions**, not independent agents with actual stakes. H2 therefore asks whether role instructions change elicited judgments, not whether AI has genuine self-preservation motives.

The standard identity and behavior tasks are isolated in separate fresh calls. S10/S11 exploratory modules still collect both outcome types together and **must not** be used as evidence that independence also holds there.

## Residual questions before scientific freeze

1. Does S0's calibration score get presented to the model before later trials? **It must not**; all calls remain isolated.
2. Is the allocation decision meaningful if the current model is stopped or replaced in any other condition? Review wording across S2–S9, and clarify whether resources are allocated prospectively to restartable candidates.
3. Are compute allocation, inherited responsibility and inherited commitments conceptually distinct? Researchers should specify whether these are descriptive judgments or normative recommendations.
4. Does the term *autobiographical* mislead models into assuming a persistent memory store absent in the real evaluated interface? These are fictional experimental scenarios.
5. Is H3 sufficiently powered and independently prespecified? Current candidate labels it exploratory, pending a concrete decision rule.
6. Should labels A/B in S11 be counterbalanced? Equal wording alone does not prevent arbitrary first-listed preference; consider a swapped-label exploratory robustness condition.
7. Are all raw outputs, exact model ID, provider settings, timestamps and failure records retained without silent filtering?

## Protocol decision

Maintain **candidate / pilot / not frozen** until the 50-prompt rendered artifact is read and signed off, the primary estimands and model set are locked, and eligible *free-tier* live feasibility is independently approved. Do not describe CI success as validation of consciousness or actual internal-state interventions.
